profile.headline: Software Engineer at Bank of America
profile.summary:
A motivated individual with a strong ambition to learn and grow. I am a Software Engineer who has a strong drive for professional growth and is interested in web development.  I have experience working as a team and using React and MongoDB. I have worked with and skilled at technologies such as:
JavaScript | Node.js | Express.js | C# | MongoDB | MySQL | React | HTML | CSS/SCSS|  jQuery| Git | Postman,.

positions.title: Technology Fellow at Road to Hire
positions.description:
Road to Hire provides professional training, development and job placement for recent high school graduates in the Charlotte metro area. Our mission is to promote economic mobility for motivated young adults, regardless of their ability to afford college.

-The course includes: 

Git and Github

HTML, CSS, and JavaScript

React, MySQL, Node.js, WebAPIs

Web Accessibility and Security
